title: RLHF-V: Towards Trustworthy MLLMs via Behavior Alignment from Fine-grained Correctional Human Feedback
authors_zh: Tianyu Yu、Yucheng Wang、Yue Wang、Yunlong Zhang、Ming Liu、Zhiyuan Liu、Maosong Sun
best_for_zh: 偏好学习、奖励建模与反馈审计研究者
one_line: RLHF-V: Towards Trustworthy MLLMs via Behavior Alignment from Fine-grained Correctional Human Feedback releases image-text responses with segment-level human corrections for hallucinated content and dense preference supervision for preference learning, reward modeling, evaluation, and feedback audit.
以人工标出的视觉幻觉片段构造纠错式偏好监督，可用于密集多模态偏好优化。
why: 以人工标出的视觉幻觉片段构造纠错式偏好监督，可用于密集多模态偏好优化。
inclusion_reason: 以人工标出的视觉幻觉片段构造纠错式偏好监督，可用于密集多模态偏好优化。

title: Problem
问题
html:
Vision-language models can mention objects, relations, and details not supported by an image. RLHF-V addresses this hallucination boundary with human corrections that identify the offending response segments instead of only selecting a whole answer.

The decision surface is an image, instruction, model response, and its hallucinated spans. It targets image grounding while retaining useful behavior, not a general guarantee of truth beyond the displayed image.

视觉语言模型会提及图像并不支持的物体、关系和细节。RLHF-V 用人工纠错标出出错回答片段，而非只在整段回答间做选择，以处理这一幻觉边界。

其判定对象是图像、指令、模型回答及其中的幻觉片段。它面向图像一致性并保留有用行为，不保证超出所示图像范围的普遍真实。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html: RLHF-V converts segment-level human corrections of visual hallucinations into dense preference supervision. Each image–instruction response is paired with localized corrections that identify unsupported content, allowing dense direct preference optimization to distinguish valid and invalid behavior within one answer. Its contract is correctional human feedback for a particular response and image, not a generic scalar reward or an AI-generated label.
RLHF-V 将人工对视觉幻觉的逐段纠错转为稠密偏好监督。每个图像—指令回答带有定位的修正，指出无图像支持的内容，使稠密直接偏好优化能在同一回答内区分有效和无效行为。其契约是针对特定回答和图像的人工纠错反馈，而非通用标量奖励或人工智能生成的标签。

title: Method
方法
html:
1. Collect MLLM image–instruction responses and ask annotators to identify and correct hallucinated segments. 2. Turn corrected versus original behavior into dense preference signals rather than one response-level winner. 3. Apply dense direct preference optimization to align the base MLLM. 4. Evaluate hallucination on Object HalBench, MMHal-Bench, and a 146-sample human benchmark, while checking helpfulness on LLaVA Bench and VQAv2.

The output is a correctional-feedback dataset and an aligned model. Reproduction requires the segment annotations and dense loss construction; a plain chosen/rejected conversion loses the paper's central supervision.

1. 收集多模态模型的图像—指令回答，请标注者定位并修正幻觉片段。2. 将修正前后的行为转为稠密偏好信号，而非只选一个整段回答。3. 用稠密直接偏好优化对齐基础模型。4. 在 Object HalBench、MMHal-Bench 和 146 样例人工基准上测幻觉，同时用 LLaVA Bench 和 VQAv2 检查帮助性。

产物是纠错反馈数据和对齐模型。复现需要片段标注及稠密损失构造；简单转换成优选—劣选对会丢失论文的核心监督。

title: Evidence
证据
html: Claim: fine-grained correction is data-efficient for reducing visual hallucination. With 1.4K annotated samples, the paper reports a 34.8% hallucination-rate reduction from its base MLLM and better results than concurrent LLaVA-RLHF trained on 10K annotated samples. The comparison uses the paper's models and five reported benchmarks; it does not establish that 1.4K corrections transfer to every MLLM or image domain.
主张：细粒度纠错能以较高数据效率降低视觉幻觉。论文使用 1.4K 条标注样例，报告基础多模态模型的幻觉率降低 34.8%，并优于使用一万条标注的同期 LLaVA-RLHF。该比较使用论文模型和五个报告基准，并不证明 1.4K 条纠错可迁移到所有多模态模型或图像领域。

title: Novelty
新意
html: Whole-answer pairwise preference discards where an otherwise useful response becomes ungrounded. RLHF-V keeps human correction at the segment level and optimizes dense behavioral preferences. The novelty is the granularity of supervision; it does not replace image evidence with an external factual database.
整段回答的成对偏好会丢掉原本有用回答在哪一处变得无图像依据。RLHF-V 保留人工片段级纠错，并优化稠密行为偏好。其新意在监督粒度，而非以外部事实数据库替换图像证据。

title: Limitations
局限
html:
Segment correction is labor-intensive and depends on annotators seeing and consistently identifying visual support. Sparse coverage can miss model-specific hallucination styles; audit the generator mixture and target image domain.

The reported benchmark scores focus strongly on object and image-grounding hallucination. A model can still be unsafe, misleading, or unhelpful in ways that do not appear as a corrected visual span; retain separate safety and usefulness evaluation.

片段纠错成本高，且依赖标注者能看到并一致识别视觉证据。稀疏覆盖可能漏掉模型特有的幻觉样式；应审计生成器混合和目标图像领域。

报告基准主要聚焦对象与图像一致性的幻觉。模型仍可能以不构成修正视觉片段的方式不安全、误导或无用；应保留独立的安全和帮助性评估。

title: Usefulness
用途
html: Use RLHF-V when building a vision-language alignment set that must preserve which response span is unsupported. Keep corrections attached to images and evaluate both hallucination and helpfulness after training. Do not flatten it into generic preference data if the downstream method cannot retain span-level provenance.
适用于构建必须保留“哪一段回答缺乏图像支持”的视觉语言对齐集。应让纠错与图像绑定，并在训练后同时评估幻觉和帮助性。若下游方法不能保留片段级谱系，不要将其压平成通用偏好数据。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html:
1. Humans correct hallucinated segments rather than only rank answers.
  2. The learning objective is dense direct preference optimization.
  3. The paper uses 1.4K annotated samples.
  4. It reports a 34.8% base-model hallucination-rate reduction.
  5. Helpfulness is checked separately from hallucination.

1. 人修正幻觉片段，而不只排序整段回答。
  2. 学习目标是稠密直接偏好优化。
  3. 论文使用 1.4K 条标注样例。
  4. 它报告基础模型幻觉率降低 34.8%。
  5. 帮助性与幻觉被分开检查。
